messages:
sam: Heads-up: customer reported new failures after their IdP rotation + our scheduled KMS rewrap last night. SSO login succeeds but SCIM provisioning returns 422 and roles are not created. stackdump attached in ticket. anyone free to triage?

nina: can you paste the relevant SAML assertion snippet and the SCIM payload? curious if attributes are arriving but transformed.

sam: gist (sanitized):
```xml
<saml:Assertion ...>
  <saml:Subject>
    <saml:NameID Format=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress\">user@example.com</saml:NameID>
  </saml:Subject>
  <saml:AttributeStatement>
    <saml:Attribute Name=\"groups\" xmlns=\"http://schemas.example.com/okta\"> 
      <saml:AttributeValue>team-eng</saml:AttributeValue>
    </saml:Attribute>
    <saml:Attribute Name=\"roles\"> 
      <saml:AttributeValue>admin</saml:AttributeValue>
    </saml:Attribute>
  </saml:AttributeStatement>
</saml:Assertion>
```

diego: interesting: one Attribute has an xmlns while the other doesn't. our SCIM-mapper treats namespace-qualified attributes as opaque and prefixes the name, so tenant mapping for `roles` isn't matched. also check the NameID format: we expect email format.

rachel: quick KMS check: the rewrap completed at 2026-03-22T02:11Z and succeeded. sig verification logs show the assertion signed with the old cert, but signature verification passed against the new cert thumbprint (IdP did key rollover with a cross-signed cert). so signatures look ok.

nina: could the KMS rewrap have changed how we fetch tenant-specific attribute mappings? e.g., encrypted config decryption failing => using fallback mapping?
sam: good call. config decrypt logs show a brief KMS throttling error at 02:09Z and we used cached config for a few minutes. cached config appears to have an older RBAC mapping (expects group `engineering` instead of `team-eng`). That could explain role creation mismatch.
diego: so two independent things: IdP added xmlns on an Attribute element (breaking name matching) + KMS hiccup made us use stale RBAC mapping. combined they result in no role assignment and 422 in SCIM.
rachel: mitigation ideas: 1) make attribute matching tolerant to namespaces (local-name match fallback) 2) patch tenant config lookup to read from cache + try immediate fresh decrypt when mapping mismatch detected, 3) add a temporary attribute-mapping override in the tenant console we can set for this customer.
nina: agree. short-term: enable tolerant parser for that tenant and force a fresh decrypt of their config. long-term: add unit tests and a feature flag to avoid regressing.

sam: I'm going to open INC-2026-045 with initial triage notes and assign to @diego for parser, @rachel for KMS decrypt tracing, @nina for console override option.

security-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-045 "IdP xmlns + KMS cache -> SCIM role provisioning fail". https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-045 :lock:

diego: I'll make a small hotfix in scim-parser that tries local-name match when ns-aware lookup fails. will run smoke against the tenant's assertion. ETA 4 hours.
rachel: I'll run an ad-hoc key fetch flow and replay config decrypt for the tenant, then invalidate cache. also will add a KMS throttle alert for the specific rewrap API so we catch this earlier.
nina: I'll add a tenant-level toggle in console (ui + api) called `allow_namespace_attr_fallback` so we can flip per-tenant. no rollout until the fix is validated.
sam: please include rollback steps in PR descriptions. also add a note to the customer that their IdP included an unexpected namespace and suggest they revert or scope the change.

deploy-bot: staged deployment queued: `scim/namespace-fallback-hotfix` -> staging. CI passed.
diego: deploying to staging now, will post results in 20m.
sam: thanks team. once staging smoke passes, enable for the single affected tenant and watch provisioning success + audit logs for role creates. also check audit chain that KMS rewrap didn't touch tenant secrets unexpectedly.
nina: ack, will run the end-to-end test and validate RBAC mappings.
rachel: adding KMS retry and alerting ticket as a follow-up.
sam: closing loop here for now. will update INC with timeline and customer comms. ping me if anything flares.
